data.evidence_sentence: Your application for admission also serves as your application for these eligible UCO international admission scholarships.
data.notes: Page lists several UCO international admission scholarships; criteria here are for the Distinguished Graduate Scholar award only. Degree level inferred from 'Graduate' in the name and the required Bachelor's degree; the page does not explicitly state master's study. Renewal requires a 3.25 GPA or higher and full-time enrollment at UCO; these apply only to keeping the award and are not entry requirements. Priority deadlines given as Nov. 1 (Spring) and May 31 (Fall) without a year. Scholarship credits are applied from the 2nd to 4th semester. GPA scale is not stated.
